section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1977
title: 27 ## Means Adopted to commit Suicides: A study of suicide cases according to the 'means adopted' for committing suicides revealed that the majority of persons commit suicide by taking poison and during 1977, 28.9 per cent suicides were committed by this most used method. The other important 'means used' for committing suicides were 'Hanging' (20.6 per cent), 'Drowning' (18.9 per cent), 'Fire' (6.6 per cent), 'Railways' (6.3 per cent), 'Jumping' (1.3 per cent), 'Weapons' (0.8 per cent), 'Fire-arms' (0.6 per cent) and 'Machine' (0.4 per cent). The suicides grouped under 'other causes' accounted for 15.6 per cent of the total suicides registered during 1977. The details are presented in Table 4.
